**B.** The appellate court will likely reverse, because the prevailing modern (agency) view does not extend felony murder to a co-felon killed by a third party such as a police officer, even though the man's gunfire started the exchange. Option C is wrong because not all states apply the rule to every death regardless of who fired the fatal shot, and D misstates the law by treating the man's initiation of the gunfire as enough.
CONFIDENCE: 72
